# Camera

*grab a front/rear frame, ask the vision model a question about it, screenshot the dashboard* — `tools/rover_camera.py`, 2 tools.

!!! abstract "From the module docstring"
    📷 Earth Rover camera tools — inline Converse image returns.

| tool | does |
|---|---|
| [`rover_see`](#rover_see) | Look through the rover's cameras. |
| [`rover_screenshot`](#rover_screenshot) | Capture composite rover views (front/rear/map) via SDK /screenshot. |

## `rover_see`

```python
rover_see(camera: str = 'front', save: bool = False) -> Dict[str, Any]
```

Look through the rover's cameras. Returns frame(s) inline so you can SEE.

Uses the SDK /v2 frame endpoints (fast, no disk I/O on the SDK side).

| argument | meaning |
|---|---|
| `camera` | "front" (default), "rear", or "both". Rear camera only exists on "zero" bot types — if unavailable, the tool degrades gracefully to front only. |
| `save` | Also write JPEG(s) to ./captures/ and report the path(s). |

**Returns**

    Dict with status and content: text summary + inline image block(s).

<small>source: <a href="https://github.com/cagataycali/scout-the-rover/blob/main/tools/rover_camera.py#L34">tools/rover_camera.py:34</a></small>

## `rover_screenshot`

```python
rover_screenshot(views: str = 'front,rear,map') -> Dict[str, Any]
```

Capture composite rover views (front/rear/map) via SDK /screenshot.

Slower than rover_see (renders via headless browser screenshots) but
includes the MAP view with the rover's position.

| argument | meaning |
|---|---|
| `views` | Comma-separated subset of: front, rear, map. |

**Returns**

    Dict with status and content: text summary + inline image blocks.

<small>source: <a href="https://github.com/cagataycali/scout-the-rover/blob/main/tools/rover_camera.py#L114">tools/rover_camera.py:114</a></small>
